details:
This update for pi-coding-agent fixes the following issues:

Changes in pi-coding-agent:

- Update to version 1.0.4 (1.0.3 was superseded the same day and
  never submitted):
  * BREAKING: provider azure-openai-responses renamed to azure,
    now also serving Azure Foundry Chat Completions
    (azure/deepseek-v4-pro first). Rename the provider key in
    auth.json (or run /login again), models.json and
    settings.json (defaultProvider, enabledModels and
    modelThinkingLevels); sessions on the old provider fall back
    and lose prompt cache. AZURE_OPENAI_* env vars unchanged
  * --tools and --exclude-tools take *-patterns and --no-mcp
    disables MCP for one run; --tools keeps MCP tools unless an
    entry starts with mcp__
  * Codemode read() on image files yields an image block image()
    shows, and image() also saves each image to a temp file for
    later turns
  * Fix fenced-code highlighting past the first line, MCP OAuth
    native-client registration, MCP shutdown racing a connecting
    server, Bedrock stalled-stream retries and frozen codemode
    built-ins, plus ChatGPT-login, EIO-on-closed-terminal and
    output-file-permission fixes
  * Many more fixes and improvements; see upstream's release notes
    for the full list
- Refresh the vendored node_modules 1.0.2 -> 1.0.4: the ten
  @earendil-works packages move to 1.0.4; nanoid, postcss and
  vite move too but are dev-only and not shipped. Still 119
  shipped modules and the licence union is unchanged
  * CVE-2026-102276 (boo#1283188): brace-expansion is 5.0.12, above
    the 5.0.10 fix floor, so the package is not affected by it
  * CVE-2026-102277 (boo#1283392) and CVE-2026-102278
    (boo#1283412): brace-expansion is 5.0.12, at the 5.0.12 and
    above the 5.0.11 fix floors, so the package is not affected
    by them

- Update to version 1.0.2: patch releases on the 1.0 API, with no
  breaking changes
  * models.json takes samplingParamsByThinkingLevel next to the
    existing samplingParams, so an OpenAI-compatible model can set
    temperature, top_p and the like separately for off, minimal, low,
    medium, high, xhigh and max. Model defaults, the effective level's
    override and the request are merged per key, modelOverrides merges
    per level, and the levels are pi's own, not the provider's
    thinkingLevelMap values. Only openai-completions, openai-responses
    and azure-openai-responses apply them
  * MCP servers can be enabled, disabled or re-scoped per project
    from a .pi/mcp.json entry without a command or url, and /mcp
    toggles a user-level server for the current project
  * oauth.clientRegistration: "cimd" identifies pi by its Client ID
    Metadata Document instead of dynamic client registration
  * pi.registerToolRenderer() picks how calls to a tool that is not
    registered yet are drawn, such as MCP tools in a resumed session
  * Cloudflare's Clef and Clef Flash classifier models are usable
    from codemode scripts and extensions
  * A codemode script printing in a loop now fails at 16 Mi
    characters or 100000 items instead of running pi out of memory
  * MCP tool calls in resumed sessions and HTML exports no longer
    render fully expanded until their server connects
  * JPEG, GIF and WebP images that extensions draw through Image now
    appear in Kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm and Warp, and fullscreen Kitty
    images no longer collapse to a one-row strip after scrolling in
    WezTerm
  * Many more fixes and improvements; see upstream's release notes
    for the full list
- Refresh the vendored node_modules over 1.0.0 -> 1.0.2: the ten
  @earendil-works packages move to 1.0.2, with pi-telemetry the one
  that was already at 1.0.2 in the 1.0.1 tree, plus
  @anthropic-ai/sdk to 0.129.0. No module leaves or joins the 119
  shipped ones and the licence union is unchanged
  * CVE-2026-102276 (boo#1283188): brace-expansion is 5.0.12, above
    the 5.0.10 fix floor, so the package is not affected by it.
    Upstream's 1.0.1 made it a direct dependency, but this package
    vendored 5.0.12 already at 1.0.0
  * CVE-2026-102277 (boo#1283392) and CVE-2026-102278 (boo#1283412):
    brace-expansion is 5.0.12, at the 5.0.12 and above the 5.0.11
    fix floors, so the package is not affected by them
- Fix the %prep comment on Source10: upstream ships no shrinkwrap
  since 1.0.1

- Update to version 1.0.0. This is a major release with breaking
  behaviour changes, not a patch release:
  * BREAKING: the interactive TUI runs fullscreen by default now,
    so the terminal's normal scrollback is gone. Set tuiMode to
    "regular" in the settings, or pass --tui-mode regular, for
    the old behaviour
  * BREAKING: MCP OAuth credentials are keyed by server name and
    URL instead of by URL alone, so two servers behind one URL can
    hold separate accounts. Credentials written by 0.99.x move to
    the first server that reads them; other servers on the same
    URL have to sign in again
  * BREAKING: MCP sign-in enforces RFC 9207 and rejects an
    authorization response whose iss names another authorization
    server. A server advertising a wrong or missing one needs the
    new oauth.authServerMetadataUrl setting
  * BREAKING: --provider without --model fails now instead of
    silently running another provider's default model
  * BREAKING: codemode scripts have to probe for a tool with
    "name" in tools; typeof tools.name no longer finds it, and
    the codemode description carries one call line per tool
    instead of the full declaration
  * BREAKING: quietStartup also takes "header", which keeps the
    version and key hints but hides the model scope line and the
    loaded-resource listing
  * Sign in with Radius from /login, which can set up the Radius
    MCP server too, and with a copy code for Anthropic when the
    browser runs on another machine
  * Codemode scripts call models.generateImages() to run image
    models with the session's credentials. Codemode needs about
    40% fewer prompt tokens and its errors now name close matches
    and the expected argument shape
  * MCP step-up sign-in keeps the scopes it already had, so a
    server asking for more no longer causes a sign-in loop
  * Fix MCP tools that tool_search loaded being dropped on resume
    and /reload, user messages keeping two full-width copies of
    every rendered line, and slash command completion after
    leading whitespace
  * Fix the memory a long assistant message keeps in the
    transcript (about a fifth of before), colour bleeding past
    highlights in fullscreen mode, and the system theme
    oversaturating pastel palettes
  * Many more fixes and improvements; see upstream's release notes
- Refresh the vendored node_modules: the ten @earendil-works
  packages go 0.99.2 -> 1.0.0 and nothing else in the 119 shipped
  modules moves, so the license union is unchanged. pi-agent-core
  drops its chord, pi-telemetry, diff, ignore and yaml deps, all
  of which other packages in the tree still pull in.
- The codemode sandbox is still WebAssembly only (quickjs.wasm
  plus five .so-named WASI modules, no ELF), so the package stays
  noarch

- Update to version 0.99.2:
  * MCP servers with the default codemode exposure no longer block
    the first prompt; they are listed in a short mcp_servers
    system prompt section and scripts find their tools with
    searchTools() and describeNamespace()
  * More MCP authentication: oauth.clientName for servers that
    only accept known OAuth clients, and "auth": {"provider": ...}
    to send a provider's /login token to an HTTP server
  * Anthropic workload identity federation from
    ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID, ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID and
    ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE
  * /reload enables tools newly added to the defaultTools setting
  * Fix codemode image() accepting malformed base64 or
    unsupported image types, which made every later provider
    request fail with HTTP 400
  * Fix codemode scripts calling the wrong MCP tool when two
    names differ only in "-" and "_"; such names now
    normalise to "_"
  * Fix new sessions intermittently ignoring the saved default
    model, or warning that no models are available, for
    extension-registered providers with a stored credential
  * Fix Anthropic requests failing when a tool schema uses
    minimum or maximum, which strict tool use rejects; such
    tools are sent non-strict
  * Fix provider retries firing immediately on an unparseable
    Retry-After date, and prompt submission slowing as a
    session grows
  * Many more fixes and improvements; see upstream's release notes
- Refresh the vendored node_modules: the ten @earendil-works
  packages go 0.99.1 -> 0.99.2 and nothing else in the 119
  shipped modules moves, so the license union is unchanged
  * CVE-2026-102277 (boo#1283392): brace-expansion is 5.0.12,
    at the fix floor, so the package is not affected by it
  * CVE-2026-102278 (boo#1283412): brace-expansion is 5.0.12,
    above the 5.0.11 fix floor, so the package is not
    affected by it

- Update to version 0.99.1 (upstream jumped from 0.87.1; no
  0.88-0.98 releases exist):
  * Codemode and MCP: model-written JavaScript runs in a QuickJS
    WebAssembly sandbox calling pi's tools in parallel; MCP servers
    over stdio/HTTP with OAuth come from mcp.json and are managed
    with /mcp and pi mcp add|remove|list|login|logout
  * New default system theme follows the terminal's own palette,
    with #rgb/oklch()/okhsl() colors and light/dark rebuilding
  * Sign in with ChatGPT on the OpenAI provider; inherited OpenAI
    Codex provider renamed "OpenAI Codex (legacy)"
  * Experimental virtual models route each request to a physical
    model; llama.cpp models gain classifier support
  * GPT-6.1 Sol joins OpenAI, Azure OpenAI and OpenAI Codex, and
    becomes the default Codex model
  * Built-in extensions and tools are named builtin:<name>,
    --no-extensions disables them too; tool APIs gain exposure,
    namespaces, annotations, structuredContent, ctx.executeTool()
  * Sessions are created on the first user message, so pi no longer
    loses them when it exits before the first response
  * Many more fixes and improvements; see upstream's release notes
- Refresh package-lock.json (now the full npm-generated lockfile,
  integrity complete) and the vendored node_modules archive:
  116 -> 119 shipped modules, with @earendil-works/pi-codemode,
  @earendil-works/pi-mcp and quickjs-wasi new, openai 6.40.0 ->
  7.19.0 and agent-base/https-proxy-agent 7.x -> 9.x; license union
  unchanged
- The new codemode sandbox ships as WebAssembly only (quickjs.wasm
  plus five .so-named WASI modules, no ELF), so the package stays
  noarch

- Update to version 0.87.1:
  * New frontier models: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol and Luna
    across providers; Grok 4.7 default for xAI
  * Fix split-turn compaction summaries refused by Claude
    Fable 5.1; invalid --mode values now error out
  * Undici 8.10.2 retained: the 8 CVE batch fixed since
    0.86.1 (CVE-2026-84961, CVE-2026-85024, CVE-2026-85008,
    CVE-2026-84947, CVE-2026-85152, CVE-2026-84890,
    CVE-2026-84933, CVE-2026-85014; boo#1279832)
- Refresh the vendored node_modules
